**[P1] Re-check revocation after retryable-error cleanup**

This raises before the `ExitStack` finishes cleanup. If an in-flight checkpoint returns without a token during cleanup, revocation is recorded, but control skips the post-`with` override and reports `RETRY` instead of bare `PENDING`. Capture retryable exceptions, finish cleanup, then return `PENDING` if revocation occurred; otherwise re-raise. Add a regression test with a retryable `InvocationError` and revocation during checkpoint-thread shutdown.
